title: Solomon Q22 compositional routing hypothesis
body: The unchanged Solomon sparse integer class head can route five quantity operations from held-out sentence-template families after the inherited first-token shortcut is removed. Every input begins with the same four-token prefix, and every target class receives a balanced wrong-operation distractor. A go requires every seed to reach 900000 exact-rate ppm, every seed-class pair to reach 800000 ppm, and at least 950000 ppm prediction agreement across seeds.
claims: The test concerns held-out paraphrase and distractor-resistant operation routing, not arithmetic answer generation.
A valid no-go would close the simple sparse class-head path for this stronger routing surface without rejecting the broader Solomon lineage.
